# id: PG-pg-87-balance-stealth
# covers: PG 195 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 7D80DBB3+ (D7A60E49 ok), harness 33087EDE+ (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: a neutral observer (Hungry Bandit, Drifters, renamed PGWatch) stands 20 m from Avarek, who sneaks
#   (detecttime: sneak on, the observer's earlier sighting reset). Result = game seconds until seen
#   (timeout 120 s). The sneaker's skill/gear varies (stealth).
#   Both are put back to their places before every point; the observer is killed at the end.
# verify: seen=1 in most points (seen=0 everywhere: this observer never notices a sneaker, send the .out to
#   the PG agent); stealth: seconds_to_seen grows with Stealth; perception: it shrinks with Perception.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Avarek
teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60
setstat Avarek stealth 30
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Avarek dist 20 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${OBS} PGWatch
relation PGWatch 0
setstat PGWatch perception 30
where PGWatch
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- w1: stealth 10, gear none ---
setstat Avarek stealth 10
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
stealth Avarek off
teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60
teleport PGWatch Avarek dist 20
speed 1
@sleep 3
@set T detecttime Avarek PGWatch timeout 120 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,195,stealth,10,0,none,w1,detect_sneaker,120,${T},-
# --- w2: stealth 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek stealth 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
stealth Avarek off
teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60
teleport PGWatch Avarek dist 20
speed 1
@sleep 3
@set T detecttime Avarek PGWatch timeout 120 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,195,stealth,90,0,none,w2,detect_sneaker,120,${T},-
# --- w3: stealth 50, gear none ---
setstat Avarek stealth 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
stealth Avarek off
teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60
teleport PGWatch Avarek dist 20
speed 1
@sleep 3
@set T detecttime Avarek PGWatch timeout 120 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,195,stealth,50,0,none,w3,detect_sneaker,120,${T},-
# --- w4: stealth 50, gear own25 ---
setstat Avarek stealth 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" stealth 25 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek stealth ~ equipped_bonus=25% .*match=1
stealth Avarek off
teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60
teleport PGWatch Avarek dist 20
speed 1
@sleep 3
@set T detecttime Avarek PGWatch timeout 120 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,195,stealth,50,25,own25,w4,detect_sneaker,120,${T},-
